auth_policies.LLD12_FIRST_RUN_SETUP_V1: credential table absent + exact Host/Origin + first-run bootstrap state; no username
auth_policies.LLD12_LOGIN_V1: exact Host/Origin + rate limit; credential table exists
auth_policies.LLD12_BROWSER_QUERY_V1: valid current-run browser session + exact Host
auth_policies.LLD12_BROWSER_MUTATION_V1: valid current-run browser session + exact Host + exact Origin + CSRF
auth_policies.LLD12_RUN_CONTROL_V1: valid current-run X-SOMA-Run-Auth + exact Host + no proxy/redirect context
auth_policies.LLD12_RUN_CONTROL_RESET_V1: LLD12_RUN_CONTROL_V1 plus native launcher password-reset operation

rules: browser and launcher credentials never substitute for each other
route adapters never log secret request fields
all mutation domain commands carry command_id except in-memory session/challenge/control mechanics
